Microsoft announces 4,800 job cuts amid Xbox restructuring

Microsoft is laying off 4,800 employees as part of a restructuring of its Xbox division. The company is reportedly aiming for growth by 2027, following a period of poor performance in 2026 which saw its stock value drop by 19%. The layoffs include a long-serving Xbox Vice President.
